{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The DSA is following the lead of the DSA Santa Cruz branch regarding this action.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Members of the DSA Santa Cruz branch are enthusiastic participants, organizers, and supporters of the strike.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA members and graduate student workers have struggled for rent control in the Santa Cruz rental market.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA members and graduate student workers have fought against tuition hikes, student debt, and university privatization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This COLA strike is the culmination of years of deep organizing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This COLA strike should be applauded as a model for solidarity work between students, labor unions and the community.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Deep organizing work is the only thing that will build a labor movement capable of rising to the challenges of the present.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Santa Cruz, California, is often ranked as one of the least affordable cities in the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Graduate student workers make around 2,000 dollars a month for nine months of the year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Graduate student workers have to stretch their pay out over the lean summer months during which they don’t get paid.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many graduate student workers are forced to take second and third jobs to support themselves.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many graduate student workers hand over more than half of their paychecks each month to their landlords.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"For many graduate students, their landlord is the UC itself.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Because of the difficulty finding affordable housing, many graduate student workers are effectively homeless and live out of cars, their offices, or friends couches.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The state of affairs for graduate student workers is a crisis and is unsustainable.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
